item.title: What the US Movement Against Data Centers Can Learn From Abroad
item.description: Paris Marx, author of Hyperscale, has been tracking global data center development for years. The US has a lot to learn from what’s happened everywhere from Ireland to New Zealand.

item.title: The PHP Meltdown Shows How AI Makes Bugs More Exploitable
item.description: Security researchers used AI tools to help uncover years-old vulnerabilities in the PHP web scripting language. Then the AI-assisted attacks began.

item.title: The Social Society Helping Women Join the AI Boom
item.description: WIRED spoke with the founders of the Aged Intelligence Society, a fast-growing events startup that brings women together to “solve midlife problems using frontier tools.”

item.title: Meet Mori, a Cute Robot Mushroom That Doesn’t Really Say (or Do) Anything
item.description: Step one in convincing people to live with robots with cameras on their faces? Disguise them as cute home decor.

item.title: Hugging Face’s New AI Biology Model Lets You Chat With DNA
item.description: The new open-source model speaks the language of DNA and can help researchers understand the effects of any changes on gene activity and health.

item.title: Hackers Exploited the PHP Vulnerabilities Days Before They Were Patched
item.description: Amazon Web Services logged attempts to leverage the internet-melting PHP2Shell bugs four days ago. They’re now being “broadly exploited” across the internet.

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg Agrees to Stay in California Despite Billionaires’ Tax Ballot Measure
item.description: Meta’s board feared that its CEO’s departure could disrupt the company’s AI ambitions. A new stock agreement gives him financial incentives to stay put.

item.title: This Startup Is All In on Recursive Self-Improvement. Its Latest Model Is Scary Good
item.description: Recursive makes the case that the benefits of using AI to build AI outweigh the risks.

item.title: Jensen Huang’s Vision for Europe Runs on Plug-In Data Centers
item.description: At Nvidia’s GTC in Berlin, Huang unveiled the company’s new plug-in data center—the DSX Pod—as the key to unlocking Europe’s AI infrastructure lag. Oh, and autonomous humanoid robotics.

item.title: ‘This Is Not a Drill’: Critical PHP Vulnerabilities Are Setting the Internet on Fire
item.description: The PHP Foundation has revealed two serious vulnerabilities that could impact millions of websites. Security experts warn that failure to quickly patch the flaws could have dire consequences.
